_meta.author: build, M28.3 (5 Oct 2026): first pass, designed per doc 33 §6.7 (the ideal stances), Act III's scoring rules (doc 27 §17.1); the oracle values are computed and asserted by the sim in M32
_meta.DO_NOT_EXPOSE: Hidden content: the ideal stance per quarter reveals the future. Read only by the reading-score system and act4End (the chapter report), plus tests/ and tools/; never by selectors, the UI during play, or player-like bots.
_meta.stance: orbital exposure: +1 = adds exposure (commit a block, a non-refundable launch booking, draw orbital debt); -1 = reduces it (insurance, selling or deorbiting early, long take-or-pay presales, cancelling bookings, an equity raise); 0 = ground and lunar moves (logged for the reveal timeline, not scored)

f1.why: On Schedule: build orbit early while launch falls; calm through the middle; cautious from 2034, when everyone's orbital supply floods and rents fall.

decoy.why: A congestion scare tempts a retreat from orbit (the Closed Shell reading) just as orbit is about to pay.

f2.why: The Wall: orbit stays dear and fragile; the right stance is cautious throughout.
f2.quiet_no_exposure_why: Design thread, 10 Oct 2026 (M36.11): a quarter with no orbital move while the player holds no orbital exposure counts as a match, like S0's calm and quiet; ground and lunar moves stay neutral. Exposure is read from the log: blocks committed or bought, less blocks sold.

decoy.why: A promotional launch price tempts a rush into orbit (the On Schedule reading); the list price never moves.

f3.why: Closed Shell: calm first; hedge as congestion climbs (insure, diversify, presell); bold after the cascade, when the survivors rebuild in the quiet shells.

decoy.why: A shelved rule tempts an early retreat (the Wall reading) before the real danger, congestion, shows.

f4.why: Cheap Ground: calm before the trigger; defensive after it, when the ground unblocks and orbit's speed premium evaporates.

decoy.why: A record capacity auction tempts a bet on orbit (the On Schedule reading) just before the ground eases.
